title: Whetstone principle pack
description: A named, versioned list of principles a repository's owner can pick from. pstack ships as the default pack; a repository adds its own under whetstone/principles/*.json. A principle id is unique across every loaded pack.

source.description: Where the principles come from: a repository, a team or a book.

commit.description: The source revision the text was read from, when it has one.

enforcer_hint.description: The enforcer kind that usually holds the principle, or none when it is held by review.
